the amyloid-β peptides in brains of transgenic APP23 mice are different from those of Alzheimer disease patients.

the identification of different amyloid-β peptides in the brains of APP23 mice and in the cerebrospinial fluid of the same transgenic mice and human AD patients.

the Aβ peptide variants found in the brains and cerebrospinal fluids of APP23 mice differ from those of AD patients.
the amyloid deposits in transgenic APP mice are not fully comparable to the amyloid plaques in AD patients.

the Aβ peptides in APP23 mice are not identical with Aβ peptides found in AD brains.

caution should be taken with the interpretation of data obtained from the analysis of Aβ peptides in mouse models of amyloid pathology.
